intro: Chicago rewards visitors with world-class museums, bold food, and a stunning lakefront. Pick how long you have and what you enjoy most.
tour_note: Check the tour page for which entry tickets are included.

notes: CTA 'L' trains run 24 hours on some lines; fares about $2.50, $5 from O'Hare.
CTA buses cover the city; pay with Ventra card or contactless.
Taxis are plentiful but pricey in rush hour; Uber and Lyft both work.
Driving is slow and parking is costly; skip a car downtown.
Walking and Divvy bike-share are great along the lakefront.
No ferries for visitors; the lakefront path is the best route.

cloudgate.name: Cloud Gate (The Bean)
cloudgate.tip: Come early morning for photos without crowds. The mirrored underside is the best angle.

artinstitute.name: Art Institute of Chicago
artinstitute.price_text: ≈ $32 adults · check current price and free days online
artinstitute.hours: Daily 11:00–17:00 · Thu until 20:00 · check on the day
artinstitute.tip: Buy tickets online and go straight to the Impressionist galleries on the upper floor.

willistower.name: Willis Tower Skydeck
willistower.price_text: ≈ $30–40 adults · book online for a time slot
willistower.hours: Daily, roughly 09:00–22:00 · check on the day
willistower.tip: Book a sunset slot. The Ledge glass boxes are busiest right after sunset.

magmile.name: Magnificent Mile
magmile.tip: Walk from the river north to Water Tower. It is about one mile of shops and old buildings.

navypier.name: Navy Pier
navypier.price_text: Free to enter · rides and cruises cost extra
navypier.hours: Pier open daily · hours vary by season
navypier.tip: Go for the lake view at the end of the pier. Skip the food court and eat elsewhere.

archtour.name: Chicago Architecture Boat Tour
archtour.hours: Departures daily spring–fall · check on the day
archtour.tip: Sit on the left side going out and bring a light jacket. The river wind is cold.

millennium.name: Millennium Park
millennium.tip: Combine with Cloud Gate and the Crown Fountain in one walk. Free summer concerts at the Pritzker Pavilion.

shedd.name: Shedd Aquarium
shedd.hours: Daily roughly 09:00–17:00 · check on the day
shedd.tip: Go at opening. The beluga and dolphin pools get crowded by midday.

grandejatte.name: A Sunday Afternoon on the Island of La Grande Jatte
grandejatte.landmark: A Sunday Afternoon on the Island of La Grande Jatte
grandejatte.hours: Same as Art Institute · check on the day
grandejatte.tip: Seurat's painting hangs in the Art Institute. Look closely at the dots up close, then step back.

americangothic.name: American Gothic
americangothic.hours: Same as Art Institute · check on the day
americangothic.tip: Grant Wood's painting is in the American art galleries. Ask staff for the room number.

brookfield.name: Brookfield Zoo
brookfield.hours: Daily roughly 10:00–17:00 · check on the day
brookfield.tip: It is a 30–40 minute drive or train ride west of downtown. Plan a half day.

culturalcenter.name: Chicago Cultural Center
culturalcenter.hours: Daily roughly 10:00–17:00 · check on the day
culturalcenter.tip: Go up to the Preston Bradley Hall to see the world's largest Tiffany glass dome. Free entry.

chicagoriver.name: Chicago Riverwalk
chicagoriver.hours: Always open · bars and boats seasonal
chicagoriver.tip: Walk the riverwalk between the lake and Wolf Point. Best light is early evening.

chicagotheatre.name: Chicago Theatre
chicagotheatre.price_text: Ticket price varies by show · marquee photo is free
chicagotheatre.hours: Box office and shows · check on the day
chicagotheatre.tip: The red CHICAGO marquee is the classic photo. Check the schedule for a show or tour.

fieldmuseum.name: Field Museum of Natural History
fieldmuseum.hours: Daily roughly 09:00–17:00 · check on the day
fieldmuseum.tip: See Sue the T. rex in the main hall. Allow at least two hours.

hauntedtrails.name: Haunted Trails (Burbank)
hauntedtrails.price_text: Pay per ride or attraction · check on the day
hauntedtrails.hours: Seasonal hours · check on the day
hauntedtrails.tip: It is a family fun park far southwest of downtown. Only worth it if you have a car.

homealone.name: Home Alone filming spots
homealone.price_text: Free to see from the street
homealone.hours: Residential street · be quiet and respectful
homealone.tip: The McCallister house is a private home in Winnetka, a train ride north. View it from the sidewalk only.

lincolnparkzoo.name: Lincoln Park Zoo
lincolnparkzoo.hours: Daily roughly 10:00–17:00 · grounds longer in summer
lincolnparkzoo.tip: Free and close to downtown. Combine with a walk along the lakefront.

mcdonalds.name: Rock 'n' Roll McDonald's (River North)
mcdonalds.hours: Daily, often 24 hours · check on the day
mcdonalds.tip: A big flagship branch with retro decor. Good for a cheap, quick meal near the river.

nighthawks.name: Nighthawks
nighthawks.hours: Same as Art Institute · check on the day
nighthawks.tip: Hopper's diner painting is in the Art Institute. It is smaller than you expect.

northwestern.name: Northwestern University (Evanston campus)
northwestern.tip: A lakefront campus about 45 minutes north by train. Nice for a quiet walk and lake views.

parisstreet.name: Paris Street; Rainy Day
parisstreet.hours: Same as Art Institute · check on the day
parisstreet.tip: Caillebotte's rainy Paris scene is in the Art Institute's Impressionist galleries.

westloopmarket.name: West Loop food walk (Randolph Street & Fulton Market)
westloopmarket.hours: Restaurants vary · busiest evenings and weekends
westloopmarket.tip: Chicago's best restaurant strip. Book dinner ahead and walk between stops.

lakefronttrail.name: Lakefront Trail walk or bike
lakefronttrail.tip: An 18-mile path along Lake Michigan. Rent a bike near Navy Pier and ride north to Lincoln Park.

riverwalkbar.name: Riverwalk evening drinks
riverwalkbar.hours: Seasonal, roughly May–October · check on the day
riverwalkbar.tip: Outdoor bars sit right on the river. Go before sunset for a seat.

lincolnparkwalk.name: Lincoln Park neighbourhood walk
lincolnparkwalk.tip: Walk from the zoo south along the lake and through leafy side streets. Good for a slow afternoon.

deepdish.name: Deep-dish pizza dinner
deepdish.tip: Deep dish takes 30–45 minutes to bake. Order as soon as you sit down.

secondcity.name: The Second City comedy show
secondcity.hours: Shows most evenings · check on the day
secondcity.tip: Chicago's famous comedy club. Book a weekend evening show and arrive early for good seats.

styles.label: Art
styles.blurb: The Art Institute, murals and gallery districts.

stays.why: Central for museums, the river walk and transit; easy walk to the lakefront.
Restaurants and galleries close by; short walk to the Magnificent Mile.
Shopping and lakefront access; good for first-time visitors.
Quieter, near the zoo and park; cheaper than downtown.

food: Try deep-dish pizza once; expect a 30–45 minute bake time, so order when you sit down.
Chicago-style hot dogs: no ketchup. Cheap lunch at many stands.
Italian beef sandwiches are a local staple; ask for it 'dipped'.
Explore neighborhood restaurants in Wicker Park, Logan Square and Pilsen for better value than downtown.
Book popular dinner spots ahead; weekends fill up fast.
more_time: Swap a downtown day for the Museum of Science and Industry or a lakefront walk in Hyde Park.
Take an architecture boat tour on the river if the weather is dry.
Spend an afternoon in Pilsen for murals and Mexican food.
